scope: Computer Control Phase 9B3C native file picker explicit semantic accept and cancel
platform: macOS Cocoa/AppKit NSOpenPanel via registered Provider and native Accessibility

safetyBoundary.addressing: registered application Provider only; exactly one running Provider process and one supported native picker
safetyBoundary.postcondition: after semantic AXPress, Provider application remains running and independent fresh filePicker.observe reports picker null
safetyBoundary.cleanup: physical harness may stop only its temporary test-owned fixture process

expectedCoverage: filePicker.observe, filePicker.selectItem and filePicker.expandDirectory remain PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED
filePicker.accept and filePicker.cancel remain IMPLEMENTED until this session passes
a real AppKit NSOpenPanel opens at PickerRoot
Alpha.txt is selected through already validated native selection semantics before accept
filePicker.accept resolves the native AXDefaultButton relationship rather than the visible Choose label
accept succeeds only when the picker is independently absent while the Provider application remains running
the AppKit completion handler independently records Picker Result: accepted Alpha.txt
the picker can be reopened after accept
filePicker.cancel resolves the native AXCancelButton relationship rather than the visible Cancel label
cancel succeeds only when the picker is independently absent while the Provider application remains running
the AppKit completion handler independently records Picker Result: cancelled
no coordinate, mouse, keyboard, clipboard, synthetic keypress, filesystem operation or label-matching fallback is used
